classification.difficultyReason: Select the cosine rule to find an included angle, then use that angle in the triangle area rule.

content.prompt: A triangular region is enclosed by straight fences of lengths 42.8 metres, 56.6 metres and 72.1 metres.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the angle between the 42.8 m and the 56.6 m fences, correct to the nearest degree.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the angle between the 42.8 m and 56.6 m fences. By the cosine rule,
$$\begin{align*}72.1^2&=42.8^2+56.6^2-2\times42.8\times56.6\cos\theta\\\cos\theta&=\frac{42.8^2+56.6^2-72.1^2}{2\times42.8\times56.6}\\\theta&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{42.8^2+56.6^2-72.1^2}{2\times42.8\times56.6}\right)\\\theta&\approx92^\circ\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the area of the region, correct to the nearest square metre.

answer.worked:
Using the unrounded value of $\theta$ from part a,
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac12 ab\sin\theta\\A&=\frac12\times42.8\times56.6\times\sin\left[\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{42.8^2+56.6^2-72.1^2}{2\times42.8\times56.6}\right)\right]\\A&\approx1211\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
